summary: Frontend-only regression on simplified Goorin dashboard (option B). Login (empty fields) navigates to dashboard-page. All required testids present. Hero shows Invoiced YTD + delta and segment tabs (all/us/dist) switch values correctly ($11.57M / $6.41M / $5.16M). Goal panel renders rv-goal-pct and rv-segment-us/dist rows. No 'Prior YTD' text on page. KPI strip tiles (open/total/forecast) show value + caption only (no legend/stacked bars). Chart card is full-width (no rv-segments-card / 'Top accounts' heading). Legend items = ['Invoiced','Open orders','Total'] (no 'Forecast'). No 'TODAY' label. Range tabs YTD/12M/Q switch. Tooltip contains Invoiced/Open orders/Total only. Export downloads goorin-revenue-by-month.csv. Accounts table heading = 'Accounts'; first row is Lids with 'Top 1' pill; rows ordered by invoiced desc. Search filters (pills hidden while searching, e.g. lids row no longer shows 'Top 1'), gibberish shows rv-account-empty. Row expand renders rv-account-expand-lids. No console page errors captured.

issues: Recharts logs benign console warnings 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' on first paint due to ResponsiveContainer measuring before layout settles. Not a blocker, but adds noise. Consider setting an explicit min-height on .rv-hero-chart / .rv-chart or setting isAnimationActive/aspect props to suppress.

action_items: Optional: suppress Recharts width/height(-1) warnings by giving chart containers a defined min-height on first mount.
critical_code_review_comments: Small: rv-strategic and rv-top5 pills are both wrapped inside <b> together with account name — a nested <em> inside <b> is fine but semantics could be improved.
TOP5/SORTED are computed at module scope which is fine since ACCOUNTS is static; keep in mind if data becomes dynamic later.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Dashboard simplification per iteration_31 verified end-to-end. All required data-testids exist and are functional. If revisiting, note the Recharts -1 warning is a first-paint measurement noise, not a functional bug.
